doubts.claim_under_doubt: a stray seam can only make the release fail closed
doubts.disproof_attempt: A stub gh prefix set alone makes publish return ok with a stub url, indistinguishable from a real success.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Mark seamed results (seam: gh). RESOLVED: create_release adds seam: gh while the gh seam is active.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: default path unchanged when no seam is set
doubts.disproof_attempt: An unreadable notes file returned a new reason before the gh preflight. RESOLVED: an unreadable notes file is left to the existing checks as before. The module-level import of release_seams widens the cache-skew failure mode the same way repo_identity already has; cache sync after merge carries the new file.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: a malformed prefix is always refused loudly
doubts.disproof_attempt: An unescaped Windows path is valid JSON with tab and newline characters and then fails as gh not found.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: RESOLVED: a prefix item with a control character is refused (test added).

doubts.claim_under_doubt: the new plugin test adds no sys.path hazard
doubts.disproof_attempt: Collection order moved the shared/scripts sys.path insertion earlier. REBUTTED: the plugin test root was run in default order and is green (114 passed); no victim found.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Green plugin root in default order.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: the offline proof skips cleanly when uv is missing locally
doubts.disproof_attempt: A missing uv raised FileNotFoundError instead of reaching the skip/fail branch.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: RESOLVED: a missing uv goes to the same skip-locally / fail-in-CI branch.

summary: No high or medium doubt. Five low doubts: four fixed, one rebutted in writing.
